prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: ONE isolated full-body 2D game character, real transparent alpha background. No text, no panels, no floor/ground shadow, no background, no aura/effects, no extra props or characters.
INPUT ROLES: Image 1 is the UNIQUE authority for this variant's identity, face, hair, anatomy/bone proportions, outfit, equipment design, colors and rendering. Its CROUCHED COMBAT POSE and 45-degree camera are NOT to be preserved: this request explicitly changes to a front idle stance. Image 2 is ONLY hand-grip anatomy / wrist-to-handle continuity reference. Never copy its adult proportions, armor, sword, cape, rendering or crossed weapon axis.
REQUEST: draw this SAME young male warrior in TRUE STRAIGHT FRONT 0 degrees, head, shoulders, chest, pelvis and BOTH feet facing the viewer. Full body in a relaxed basic standing idle. Both soles flat, feet naturally about shoulder width, knees nearly straight but relaxed, level shoulders, arms hanging comfortably beside hips with slightly relaxed elbows. He holds his longsword in anatomical RIGHT hand (SCREEN LEFT) and his SHORT angular dagger in anatomical LEFT hand (SCREEN RIGHT), BOTH naturally LOWERED downward alongside the body. Blade tips point toward the ground slightly away from the feet. Weapons are not raised, not crossed in front of chest or legs, no fighting crouch, no action, no walking. Gaze forward with the original composed determined youthful male impression.
IDENTITY/EQUIPMENT: layered spiky GOLDEN BLOND hair, brown eyes, silver plate armor, blue scarf and SHORT lowered hood, blue waistcloth, brown belt/pouches/trousers. Anatomical RIGHT shoulder SCREEN LEFT has crescent emblem and layered pauldron; RIGHT shin SCREEN LEFT has silver plate greave. Anatomical LEFT shin/boot SCREEN RIGHT is blue wrapped cloth with metal protectors. Longsword has blue diagonal blade inlays, silver wing-shaped guard, gold guard center and ring knuckle guard; dagger is SHORT with an angular blade. Exactly two natural arms/hands, exactly these two weapons. Fingers wrap real handles, not pommels/blades; thumb opposes four fingers, connected forearm/wrist/palm. No new insignia, no long cape, no new weapons.
PROPORTIONS: retain the head-to-chest, skull/face, torso-to-limb and hand/boot proportions of image1, do not normalize to a generic chibi or long adult master. Straightening the crouch naturally changes visible full height, NOT actual head size or limb lengths. Keep his existing face and skull; do not inflate hair instead.
FRAMING: include all hair spikes, both full soles and every blade tip/guard in the canvas with roughly 10% transparent safety margin all around. Place the connected character AND held equipment as a single comfortably centered composition. Do not stretch or crop.
RENDERING: Match image1 precisely: angular jagged hair planes and angular cloth/armor shapes, firm thin dark colored contour, matte decisive hard cel-shadow blocks with restrained glints. Compact SD bone proportions. Do not round it into the soft shaded variant4, do not paint subtle textured shading over the flat angular cells.
inputRoles: unique variant style/proportions/identity; old pose replaced
grip anatomy only; not weapon angle, physique or outfit
